rule: Every file changed by the T22 preconstruction delta is declared here with its reason, expected behavioral effect, and regression coverage. No unrelated improvements are included. Files absent from this manifest must be byte-identical to the T22 base commit (9fc953468921e527d5c340b6e69bb1c3ea48c7a9).

old_candidate_identity.note: T21R17 official evaluation candidate identity (permanently closed; never continued)
old_candidate_identity.candidate_runtime: frozen R16/R17 runtime (classify_query_freshness(query) without request date; no present-state fact-class intent; no post-retrieval metadata rule)

new_candidate_identity_rule: the remediated candidate is the T22 runtime delta below; its identity is the t22-preconstruction branch commit that carries the runtime repair (recorded in T22_candidate_identity.json at commit time)

changed_files.reason: T21R17 root cause: the runtime classified every temporal family from a lexical cue list only; the 250 blind temporal rows carried no candidate-visible signal, so all routed to the frozen snapshot (explicit_current_routing_accuracy 0/70, 70 stale-current answers). The repair introduces the frozen five-intent temporal classifier (STATIC, HISTORICAL_AS_OF, CURRENT_REQUIRED, RECENCY_SENSITIVE, AMBIGUOUS_FRESHNESS) with the staleness-aware action mapping, the explicit request-date input (signal-carrier E), the present-state role/value lexicons, superlative time-scoping, physics-sense suppression, record-pinning and self-contained referent frames, all frozen in evaluations/t22/temporal_signal_contract.json.
changed_files.expected_behavioral_effect: queries with an explicit current-information requirement or a present-state fact class route to web research exactly when the request date is past the frozen snapshot (or unknown, fail-safe, for CURRENT_REQUIRED); record-pinned, historical as-of, timeless, and unscoped-superlative shapes answer from the frozen frame; physics-sense and proper-noun 'current' no longer trigger routing
changed_files.regression_coverage: tests/test_t22_temporal_router.py (intent classification, no-stale-fallback invariant, static invariant, section-24 false-positive fixes, backward-compatible keys, no-wall-clock determinism); evaluations/t22/temporal_regressions qualification battery

changed_files.reason: carry the frozen temporal_intent additively through knowledge_eligibility so callers, traces, and evidence rows distinguish the five intents; the routing decision logic itself is unchanged (boundary > freshness > eligible).
changed_files.expected_behavioral_effect: eligibility dicts gain temporal_intent; no routing outcome changes

changed_files.reason: two repair threads: (1) thread the caller-supplied request date into the freshness classifier (answer_knowledge(now=...) now reaches classify_query_freshness instead of being ignored), binding the snapshot date from the corpus; (2) insert the post-retrieval metadata rule (signal-carrier B): a stale snapshot plus retrieved TIME_SENSITIVE source metadata routes to web research for STATIC-not-pinned and AMBIGUOUS intents, which is the deterministic discriminator for the metadata-only explicit-current sub-shape (protocol section 25).
changed_files.expected_behavioral_effect: queries whose only candidate-visible temporal signal is runtime metadata (request_date beyond snapshot, TIME_SENSITIVE source) now route instead of answering stale snapshot state as current; queries with STATIC source metadata and identical text still answer
changed_files.regression_coverage: tests/test_t22_temporal_router.py::test_metadata_only_carrier_rule, test_metadata_rule_exempt_for_record_pinned, test_metadata_rule_requires_stale_request; static_unnecessary_web regression family in the qualification battery

changed_files.reason: contract-driven temporal row authoring: an optional author-spec row_authoring block preregisters per-tag query templates, deterministic sub-shapes, per-tag source freshness classes, the candidate-visible request_date carrier, and per-tag expect_status (ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH for the explicit-current family). Absent block reproduces the frozen R16/R17 row authoring byte-identically (default branch unchanged).

changed_files.regression_coverage: t22 preconstruction exact-design audit, signal-carrier audit (gold-only-signal rows = 0), and backward-compat row-hash equality assertions in the preconstruction script
